page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, then a table of Greek abbreviation signs in four columns separated by vertical rules, with no text below. Margins are blank apart from scan stains and handwritten marks, which are left out.

page.notes: The Greek abbreviation ligatures are small and tightly set, so most forms are approximate; each uncertain form carries [?]. The left-hand column of the table is partly faded and several cells could not be read letter by letter. Vertical rules separate the four column groups. Smudges and handwriting were not transcribed.
